note: env columns are present but NULL until CDS access is granted; no model consumes them yet - `src/era5.py` is the fetch layer only.
help:
ERA5 fetch is not available. To enable it:
  1. pip install cdsapi xarray netcdf4
  2. create ~/.cdsapirc with your CDS API key
     (https://cds.climate.copernicus.eu/how-to-api)
  3. accept the 'ERA5 hourly data on pressure/single levels' licence
Until then, env columns are written NULL and no model uses them.
